facefinder.bin: pre-trained frontal-face cascade distributed in the MIT-licensed pico repository.
Source: https://github.com/nenadmarkus/pico/blob/7d550c78b2c31a4e1dfc5bcdfe9da013297b5cc8/rnt/cascades/facefinder

Licence: pico.LICENSE.txt, Copyright (c) 2013 Nenad Markus.

Method: N. Markus, M. Frljak, I. S. Pandzic, J. Ahlberg and R. Forchheimer,
"Object Detection with Pixel Intensity Comparisons Organized in Decision Trees", https://arxiv.org/abs/1305.4537

The detector uses a downsampled grayscale copy of the photo, entirely on the device. It detects approximately frontal
faces, not identities or demographic attributes. Profile, small, tilted or obscured faces may need manual placement.
Detected bounds are approximate and should be reviewed before makeup is applied. No images leave the device.
